recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core FHIR source follow-up is needed for this issue unless a future PA decision changes Encounter.subject or the subject search parameter.
issue_request: FHIR-21770 was a Published/Persuasive PA change request asking that the Encounter:patient search parameter documentation stop mentioning Group because the expression is Encounter.subject.where(resolve() is Patient).
initial_application: No FHIR-21770-tagged commit was found in Encounter source history. The requested wording correction was already applied by same-change-family commit f3156be190 (#FHIR-13601), which changed Encounter-patient from "The patient or group present at the encounter" to "The patient present at the encounter".
additional_context: Encounter is active in source/fhir.ini. The separate Encounter-subject search parameter still says "The patient or group present at the encounter" and uses expression Encounter.subject, which is consistent with subject covering Patient and Group and is outside the patient-only correction.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch; the authoritative current source already satisfies FHIR-21770.
